_comment: Derived from a live probe run, not guessed. Yahoo's markup changes without notice - re-run `python -m waiver_window.probe --deep` and correct these. No code change needed.
_note_search: Yahoo ignores search= on the players page; every variant returned the full 120-row page. So the tool loads the available-player list and scans it client-side instead.
_note_status: td[3] holds ownership. An owned player shows the fantasy team name linked to /f1/{league_id}/{team_number}. A free agent or waiver player shows a text label instead.
_note_add: Add links are signed with a per-session crumb token, so they are scraped from the row rather than constructed. Calibrate submit/confirm with `probe --add "Player Name"`.
